caption:
Scientists just proposed a forgotten particle explains why matter exists, but what if matter and antimatter annihilated each other completely? In the early cosmos, equal parts matter and antimatter should have collided and cancelled out. Without this particle tipping the scale, no protons or atoms could ever survive. Instead of stars, galaxies, and life, the universe would be an empty expanse of pure radiation expanding forever in silence. Could complex life ever evolve without physical matter? Follow for more what-ifs.

Based on today's news: Scientists say a forgotten particle may explain why the universe exists - Science Daily
